newsitem.title: PERU: Blast at Peru air force weapons store injures six.
newsitem.headline: Blast at Peru air force weapons store injures six.

text.p: A series of explosions at an air force weapons warehouse late on Monday blasted missiles, bombs and debris into a neighbouring residential block, injuring six people including a young girl, Peru's military said on Tuesday.

The 6-year-old girl had head injuries after the late-night explosions launched weapons and parts of the warehouse roof into a housing complex for police officers' families in Piura, 625 miles (1,000 km) north of Lima, military spokesmen said.

Television images on Tuesday showed residents holding unexploded rockets and bombs sprayed onto their homes during the explosions, which also blew out windows and damaged the roofs of some houses. Firefighters worked into the early morning hours to control the flames at the warehouse following the blast, the air force said. Its cause was unknown.
